Problem Description

The laser head moves beyond the expected working area along the X-axis, or the actual movement distance differs from the expected distance during a job.

For example, the laser head may travel farther than expected even when the design fits within the machine's working area.

Causes

Possible causes include:

  • The device's working area or machine dimensions are configured incorrectly in LightBurn.
  • The design size or position exceeds the available working area.
  • The machine's movement settings or controller configuration may be incorrect.

Solution

  1. Check the design size and position. Make sure the design fits within the machine's working area.
  2. Check the device settings in LightBurn. Confirm that the configured working area matches the machine's actual dimensions.
  3. Test the X-axis movement. Use a simple test to compare the expected movement distance with the actual distance.
  4. Check the movement settings. If the X-axis still travels farther than expected, review the machine's motion configuration and controller settings.
  5. Contact technical support if the issue persists. Provide the machine model, serial number, actual movement distance, expected distance, and relevant speed settings to help identify the cause.

Note: If the X-axis movement distance changes depending on the speed setting, record the speed and distance for each test. This information can help determine whether the issue is related to motion configuration or another mechanical or electrical problem.

 

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
